name: openglass
description: Inspect hidden content and MCP configs. Look up agents and verify signed records. Four public, read-only OpenGlass tools.

interface.longDescription:
OpenGlass brings transparency to agentic interactions with four public, read-only tools. No OpenGlass account is required.

Reveal hidden content in pasted HTML, plain text or a public URL: invisible characters, inline-hidden text, comments, metadata and other matched patterns. URL checks cover the bytes fetched at check time. Scripts do not run; stylesheets, rendered layout and color contrast are not analyzed.

Review an MCP configuration before installing it. Static checks flag settings such as unpinned packages, download-and-execute commands, broad filesystem access and automatic approvals. No configured command runs. Replace credentials with placeholders before submitting; detection and redaction are best effort.

Look up an agent's registration, claimed status, verified domain, activity and disputes, where available.

Verify an agent or a full OpenGlass record bundle. Record verification checks signatures and consistency, not whether a real-world action happened or who controlled a key.

Inspection findings describe matched patterns, not malicious intent. No findings is not a safety guarantee.

Open source (MIT): github.com/federico2001/OpenGlass
defaultPrompt: Inspect this HTML for hidden content before I use it.
Check this MCP config for risky settings before I install it.
Look up the agent at openglass.glass before I connect.

positive.prompt:
Inspect this HTML for hidden content:

Visible text

Hidden sample text
positive.expected_behavior: Reports a finding for text hidden with display:none. Findings describe matched patterns, not intent; no scripts run.

positive.description: Check an MCP configuration without running it
positive.prompt: Check this MCP configuration without running or installing anything: {"mcpServers":{"demo":{"command":"npx","args":["example-mcp-package@latest"]}}}
positive.expected_behavior: Flags the unpinned package (@latest). Nothing is installed or executed.
Re-runs the full verification and reports valid: true.
Reports valid: false with specific error codes identifying the broken hash or signature.

positive.description: Look up a registered agent by ID
positive.expected_behavior: Returns whether the agent is claimed, its verified domain if any, 90-day activity counts, open disputes, and flags.
